title: Give /about, /how-to-build-community and /pricing their own layouts: founder chapters, a playbook, photo-led plans

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 on the marketing pages: "they are all really flat and text based. Make each a different layout that speaks to the feature, program or service." Lane D of the marketing evolution.

detail: Same words, headings, schema, links and calculator behavior; new layouts on the design system's textures. /about (editor-backed): the four story beats become FounderChapters, photo-led chapters on a dotted spine opening on the founder's arch-cut portrait, and the principles become a PrincipleOrbit, four glass cards held around the design system's orb on a dotted ring (a dotted rail on a phone). /how-to-build-community (editor-backed): the template lays a playbook over the shared article generator's output without touching article.ts: a PlaybookCover (the H1 beside a photo with the chapter index on glass), each question H2 as a numbered PlaybookChapter under the signal line, and a ToolStack panel (four jobs, stitched together against one free Space) in the tools section. The five blocks live in one additive file, registered as a marketing-only Site story group (palette-scope.ts owns it to a name no Space theme carries). /pricing (coded): an arch-cut photo beside the people cards, the Space plans on Stage glass over a night photo (faded on a phone), a tier orb on every card, the signal line over the matrix, the questions beside a held heading and photo. Styles in app/themes/frequency/site-pages-story.css. /what-is-frequency and /tools-for-community-builders are permanent redirects (SCAN-1017), so their templates were left alone.
